snippet.title: Hotline Miami 2: Her Relentless Crusade - Campaign Release Trailer
snippet.description:
1890, Eastern Europe. Assassinations threaten to collapse the already-unstable Livonian Empire. Princess Tishina and her allies are the nation's last shot at restoring order. Dynamite, clubs, lever-action shotguns, and more will let you lay waste to your enemies. Eleven levels, multiple endings, and plenty of secrets await players. Enough hiding from the monsters terrorizing your home - time to get sweet, sweet revenge.

Steam Workshop - https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3478286241
Google Drive - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Biui6rwoiL5ZccHRiBH-96Ph4to5kZXk/view?usp=sharing

Required Mods:
HRC Music Mod - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lt1aNZ5Mm2Ua5pOugwHfsRsEe9eNCS3C/view?usp=drive_link
HRC Manual patchwad - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Gm-qUTnXZxnaFAHXjVrsYRyyyKqsAi2s/view?usp=sharing

Song featured: "The Final Showdown" by Jyc Row.

Thank you to everyone who supported and believed in this project. I'm so happy to see it come to fruition after so long! I hope you all enjoy this labor of love. :)
